description: Reads blockchain state; the observation does not execute transactions or modify the target wallet/contract. An authorized USDC service payment is separate. Execution can charge USDC or prepaid credits, consume trial quota and update Fresh402 records. A new charge requires prior spending authorization. Without billing/trial credentials, a valid call returns an unpaid quote without executing the observation. Read contract-reported token identity, metadata, supply and limited control facts at one pinned finalized Base block. No safety score, honeypot/trading simulation, verified-source claim or inferred absence of privileges. Missing or deceptive getter evidence remains unknown/not_assessed. $0.010000 native USDC/call on Base (eip155:8453); compatible x402 or enabled native MPP client required, no Fresh402 token for first purchase. Save proof/input and private recovery token BEFORE paying for full-response-loss protection: REST X-Fresh402-Recovery-Token; MCP params._meta['fresh402/recovery-token']. Recover originals without new RPC/debit; foreign snapshot/cursor forbidden. Provider failure/partial scan is not paid success. observation_saved=false/persistence_error: recover only, never use unsaved IDs. Prepaid needs eligible finalized all-service credits or an original explicit service-specific tariff4 grant; inspect /v3/prepaid/quote/token_facts and /v3/prepaid/all-services. Historical Web rights unchanged; paying agents do not need their own RPC credentials. Observations30days, private financial recovery7days. Not full history, financial advice or security audit. Clients: https://fresh402.com/docs#payments. Free signed trial: /v3/agent-trial requires an unfunded EOA ownership signature; human Web trial: /v2/trial. Eligibility/capacity may return429. Use only X-Fresh402-Trial-Key plus persisted Idempotency-Key; replay exact tool/input/key. Exhaustion never authorizes a charge.

address.description: 20-byte Ethereum address; lowercase/uppercase accepted, mixed case must have a valid EIP-55 checksum. Normalized to checksummed form.

block.description: Finalized only. Every state read pins the selected block hash with requireCanonical:true; no latest/number fallback.

categories.description: Requested categories, default all. Unsupported evidence remains unknown/not_assessed; never a safety score.

chain_id.description: Base mainnet only; returned provider chain must match.
